profile.name: Deckers Outdoor Corporation
profile.description: We are a global leader in designing, marketing, and distributing innovative footwear, apparel, and accessories developed for both everyday casual lifestyle use and high-performance activities. We market our products primarily under three proprietary brands: HOKA, UGG, and Teva.
